verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents authentication-related events, namely brute-force lockout events (user disabled by permanent or temporary lockout), and users can view account history. This is a glancing sign that Keycloak captures authentication activity. Nothing in the pack shows admin-activity auditing, tamper-evidence, or a documented way to stream or export audit events to a SIEM; the OpenTelemetry and metrics guides cover observability telemetry, not audit logs. Missing for 10: admin event capture, tamper-evident or integrity-protected logs, documented SIEM streaming or export (event listeners or log forwarding), full catalog of auth event types, independent corroboration.
